scares.description: Vicky startles Burt in bed by blowing a party horn.
Burt slams on his brakes as he sees a child standing on the road.
The child lying on the road suddenly jumps up at Vicky. [Video].
A knife lands on the monopoly board.
The corn stalks part in front of Burt.
A cult member jumps up from the back seat as Burt gets into the car.
